newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says bought 25,000T palm oil at tender.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says bought 25,000T palm oil at tender.

text.p: Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries said on Thursday it had bought a total 25,000 tonnes of palm oil and palm stearin from Felda, 5,000 tonnes more than the amount traders reported.
Moharram Ghanem said he had bought 15,000 tonnes of palm oil and not just 10,000 tonnes. He confirmed the price per tonne was $534.5 C+F.
Ghanem also said he bought 10,000 tonnes of palm stearin for $404 a tonne.
